recommendation.first_topic: Adapt patch 0064 into a pure text-to-dt-schema conversion for the already-upstream MT6797 AFE driver. Delete Documentation/devicetree/bindings/sound/mt6797-afe-pcm.txt in the same change, preserve all eight ordered clocks, and make no DTS or driver change.
recommendation.following_topic: Adapt patch 0045 only after the schema topic: add the missing mt6797-power.h include, place the disabled AFE node in unit-address order, and validate it against the accepted schema. Do not add or enable a codec or machine card.

local_inputs.use: adds MT6351 parent and child compatibles, including mediatek,mt6351-sound, to the locally patched v7.1.3 binding
adds the MT6351 parent match, core data and mt6351_devs table with its sound cell to the locally patched v7.1.3 package
frozen sanitized project record only; linked private evidence was not opened

official_v7_1_3.finding: The official stable v7.1.3 binding and MFD core omit MT6351. Local patches 0008 and 0010 introduce that support in the project package.

provenance_reconciliation.july_statement_scope: The July audio experiment's mt6351_devs statement applies to its locally patched v7.1.3 package and remains valid historical evidence for that package.
provenance_reconciliation.local_additions: Patch 0008 adds the MT6351 binding compatibles. Patch 0010 adds the MT6351 parent match, core data and mt6351_devs table, including the mt6351-sound cell.
provenance_reconciliation.upstream_comparison: The inspected official stable v7.1.3 binding/core and pinned current-mainline binding/core omit those additions.
provenance_reconciliation.interpretation: The current-mainline omission is provenance, not evidence of an upstream regression or removal.

history_inputs.finding: Kai Chieh Chuang introduced both MT6797 audio text bindings in 2018.
The accepted MT8173 AFE conversion created the vendor-prefixed YAML file and deleted the legacy text file in the same patch.

negative_lookups.meaning: MT6797 selections live in the current central sound/soc/mediatek/Kconfig.
Current MT6797 AUDIO domain data remains in the legacy mtk-scpsys.c implementation.

negative_lookups.query: bounded exact-string public search for mt6797-afe-pcm YAML and mediatek,mt6797-audio
negative_lookups.meaning: No overlap was found; this is not proof of universal absence.

current_findings.clock_contract: seven clocks acquired by mt6797-afe-clk.c plus mtkaif_26m_clk acquired by the ADDA DAPM clock-supply widget
current_findings.soc_dependencies: all eight clock providers, the MT6797 AUDIO power-domain ID and its scpsys implementation are present
current_findings.machine_driver: present and requires mediatek,platform plus mediatek,audio-codec phandles
current_findings.mt6351_mfd_parent: absent from official v7.1.3 and the inspected current MFD core and binding; present in the July experiment's locally patched v7.1.3 package through local patches 0008 and 0010, so current absence is not an upstream regression or removal
